description: Defines an immutable class ImmutableJsonParseOptions implementing JsonParseOptions, encapsulating options for JSON parsing such as URL decoding.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonParseOptions
classes.description: Immutable implementation of JsonParseOptions, providing a thread-safe, value-based object for JSON parsing options.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new ImmutableJsonParseOptions with specified applyUrlDecoding setting.

methods.name: isApplyUrlDecoding
methods.description: Returns whether URL decoding should be applied during JSON parsing.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare ImmutableJsonParseOptions instances based on applyUrlDecoding property.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode using the hash of applyUrlDecoding.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides string representation including class name and applyUrlDecoding value.
